description: Find theme files in a Fudge draft. With `pattern`, search contents by regular expression; without it, list files matching `paths` globs.

paths.description: Files, folders or glob patterns, e.g. ["sections", "snippets/*price*.liquid"].

pattern.description: Regular expression (RE2 syntax: no lookarounds or backreferences) to search for in those files.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: search_draft_files
title: Search draft files
